is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l., specifically Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae (page 5, Section 2.4; page 9, Tables 3 and 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotypes Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (page 5, Section 2.4; page 9, Tables 3 and 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 and Table 4 (page 9) report exact genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample sizes for L1014F and G119S by locality and species.

african_field_population.evidence: Larval surveys were conducted in December 2022 across multiple localities in southern Benin (Sô-Ava, Ouidah, Placodji, Gbégamey, Ayélawadjè, Zogbo, Adjarra, Adjohoun) and reared to adults (page 1, Abstract; page 4, Section 2.2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical research article reporting original field collections, bioassay, biochemical, and molecular data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Localities and communes specified in southern Benin: Ouidah, Sô-Ava, Cotonou (Placodji, Gbégamey, Ayélawadjè, Zogbo), Adjarra, and Adjohoun, along with geographic coordinates (pages 3-4, Section 2.1 and Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected in December 2022 (page 1, Abstract; page 4, Section 2.2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field surveillance collections conducted by the Centre de Recherche Entomologique de Cotonou (CREC) with no indication of prior publication.

supplement.evidence: All relevant genotype counts and frequencies are reported in full within Table 3 and Table 4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and resistance mechanisms in Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae collected as larvae in December 2022 across eight localities in southern Benin (Atlantic, Littoral, and Oueme departments). Susceptibility was tested against pyrethroids alone and with PBO in WHO tube tests, and against chlorfenapyr in CDC bottle tests. Genotype counts for Vgsc L1014F and Ace-1 G119S are fully reported by locality and species.
